name: Pincer (Teamwork)
body:
You and your team are adept at crushing opponents between your vehicles.

Prerequisites: Mounted Combat.

Benefit: When you make a successful ram attack against an enemy vehicle and your ally with this feat is driving a flanking vehicle, you deal double ram damage.

Normal: You deal standard ram damage even with flanking ally vehicles.
